svg.title: Open Moon base power build-out by stage
svg.desc: Seven panels following milestone M04's step-by-step plan. 1: first 10 kW VSAT tower with power management controller (PMC) main switching unit A, a starter battery string and a cable rover. 2: second VSAT on a second ridge point, within 3 km of cable run of the PMC as standard or up to 10 km as an extended run. 3: more 10 kW VSAT towers, number still to be decided. 4: regenerative fuel cells, charged by PMC surplus and discharging only into the battery. 5: PMC main switching unit B with the reactor ride-through battery strings and the cross-tie. 6: the LR-1-class reactor, 1 to 3 km away behind terrain, starting into its parasitic load radiator and then switched over to feed the PMC. 7: the grid closed so it survives the loss of any single source.
svg.text: BASE POWER BUILD-OUT · M04 STEP BY STEP
Bright = added at this step; faded = already in place. Every source feeds the PMC (DD-003, DD-008).
